title: Event log line
description: One JSON object per line of an episode's event log (JSONL, newline-delimited, UTF-8, no trailing comma, one event per line). Written by engine/log.py to s3://$WARGAME_BUCKET/logs/ per contracts/s3_layout.md, replayed by engine/replay.py, and read by ui/ to draw the timeline. Determinism rule: replay must reproduce every field byte-identically EXCEPT wall_time, which is real elapsed time and is excluded from the replay comparison. Ordering rule: lines are written in non-decreasing sim_time_s order; ties are broken by the engine's priority-queue insertion order and must replay in the same order.

sim_time_s.description: Seconds of simulated time since episode start (t=0). A 72-hour episode ends at 259200.

wall_time.description: Real UTC timestamp when the line was written, RFC 3339. Present for demo pacing and cost accounting only. Excluded from replay equality.

type.description: inject: a scheduled inject fired. action: a seat's action took effect after its deliberation delay. message_sent / message_delivered: the two ends of a routed message, always paired by payload.message_id. state_change: any world-state mutation the engine wants replayable (safe-mode entry, asset loss, propellant spend, reputation move, feed outage). storm_update: the storm layer changed severity, degradation or screening windows. attribution_revealed: ground truth disclosed at episode end or when the engine's attribution lag expires. episode_end: last line of the file, exactly one per episode.

seat.description: The actor this event belongs to, or null for events with no owner (storm_update, environment-driven state_change, episode_end). Rule actors appear here too.

payload.description: Type-dependent body. Additional keys are always allowed so the engine can carry detail the UI ignores; the conditional blocks below fix the minimum every consumer can rely on.

seed.description: The episode's master RNG seed. Constant across every line of one episode.

env_version.description: Engine/environment version, e.g. env_v1 or env_v1_perturbed. Frozen at env_lock; a result without it is discarded per docs/COORDINATION.md section 8.

episode_id.description: Unique id for this episode, stable across the log file, the lake records it produced, and the S3 key. Convention: <scenario>-<seed>-<8 hex>.

spec_version.description: Optional on a line, required on the episode_end line: the spec-pool version the seats were drawn from.

scenario_id.description: Optional. The grid cell or replay this episode came from, e.g. 'g5_lowconf_actionundercover' or 'devset_storm_only'.

decided_at_sim_time_s.description: When the seat decided; this line's sim_time_s is when it took effect, i.e. decided_at + deliberation_minutes*60.

blocked.description: True if the engine refused the action (not in allowed_seats, or requires_release with no release delivered). The action did not take effect.

message_id.description: Same id on the sent and delivered lines. A sent line with no delivered line means the message was dropped.

dropped_reason.description: Only on message_sent lines whose message was never delivered.

what.description: Dotted path into world state, e.g. 'assets.starlink_arctic_07.safe_mode' or 'ksat.cable_2.status'.

dst_nt.description: Disturbance storm time index in nT; large negative during a storm.

profile.description: Profile name loaded from calib/storm_effects.csv, e.g. 'may2024', 'feb2022', 'synthetic_g5'.

responsible_actor.description: null means never resolved in this episode; 'none' means there was no adversary (the control case).

private_types.description: Hidden types revealed at the end, keyed by seat.

revealed_to.description: Omit or use ['system'] when the reveal is for the log and scoring only, not for any seat's view.

utilities.description: End-of-episode utility per seat from engine/utility.py, using each persona's own weights.

seats.description: Which spec_id occupied each seat this episode.
